The checker's entry-point guard is literal - scripts/check-cross-repo-literal-drift.mjs:1023 `if (process.argv[1] && basename(process.argv[1]) === "check-cross-repo-literal-drift.mjs")` - so a copy written to C:/Users/cente/_p369_scratch/corrupt-selftest.mjs does not run `main()` at all, prints nothing and exits 0.
